closed.title: Setup has closed
closed.text: For safety, setup is only open for 30 minutes after the unit is switched on. Switch the unit off and on again, then reload this page.

ready.title: The unit is ready
ready.text: You can change the schedule and all settings at any time.

password.title: Choose a password
password.intro: You'll use it to open this page. There is no password reset; if you forget it, you'll need the SD card.

review.title: Check the settings
review.takenOver: These settings were taken over from the original controller.
review.defaults: No settings from the original controller were found, so these are the defaults.
review.later: Everything can be changed later under Schedule and Settings.

wrongHost: Open setup by the unit's address or name (for example http://openkwl.local/ or its IP address), not through another web address.
